args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip flops
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloë vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Water shoes
- Beach bag
- Quick-dry clothing

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots/shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Rain jacket (weather can change quickly)
- Daypack/backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent

PERSONAL CARE:
- Toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, etc.)
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hairbrush/comb
- Deodorant

ELECTRONICS:
- Phone adapter/converter if needed
- Headphones
- Laptop/tablet (optional)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/magazines for relaxation
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11: Waikiki Beach - Beach toys, cooler
- June 12: Hanauma Bay Snorkeling - Underwater camera
- June 13: Diamond Head Hiking - Trekking poles, trail map
- June 14: Pearl Harbor - Respectful attire
- June 15: North Shore Road Trip - Car snacks, playlist
- June 16: Polynesian Cultural Center Luau - Nice casual outfit
- June 17: Hotel Spa Day - Spa sandals, robe (if not provided)
- June 18: Kailua Beach Kayaking - Waterproof watch
- June 19: Ala Moana Shopping - Reusable shopping bags
